ideas.title: The Prevalence of Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the recent cases of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the charges against 7 individuals and the Fargo woman accused of using professionals' identities.
ideas.angle: Exploring the scope and impact of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are these cases being investigated and prosecuted?
ideas.insight: The recent cases of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota suggest a need for further investigation into healthcare fraud in the state, potentially involving multiple entities and officials.

ideas.title: The NYC Bribery Probe: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: An examination of the bribery scheme involving NYC Mayor's former chief of staff, Frank Carone, and the implications for corruption in government.
ideas.angle: Investigating the scope and impact of the bribery scheme
questions: What is the extent of the bribery scheme?
How does this relate to broader issues of corruption in government?
ideas.insight: The indictment of Frank Carone and the arrest of other officials suggest a need for further investigation into corruption in government, potentially involving multiple entities and officials.
